subject: How to fix items (without estimating theta)

messages.author: c5cdb9809bf563a4
messages.subject: How to fix items (without estimating theta)
parts:
Hello, everyone.

In CAT (Computerized Adaptive Testing), I understand that the items administered are random, but is there a way to fix the items to be administered? Also, I want to set it up so that theta is not estimated in this case.
For example, how should I proceed if I want them to answer questions about their age, gender, etc. first, and then take a test by CAT? In this case, it is not necessary to estimate theta for age and gender.

If possible, I'd like to present the same question to all test takers at the nth position during the execution of the CAT. Of course, even here, it's not necessary to estimate theta for this question.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: How to fix items (without estimating theta)
parts:
Hi Tatsuki,

Have you read the associated mirtCAT paper in JSS? Item administration does not have to be random, and indeed you can select the exact ordering of the item presentation when building the corresponding model elements. Regarding your second question, you can use the constrain input not_scored to indicate that an item should be administered but not used in the scoring process (only collected). There's an example on the wiki here: http://philchalmers.github.io/mirtCAT/html/unidim-newitems.html

Phil
